name: そのトークンは、どのworkflowのもの？
shortDescription: GitHub Actions OIDCのAWS production roleを、正しいaudience・repository・environmentへ束縛しよう。
description: 長期AWS secretをOIDCへ置き換えたが、production roleのstarter trust policyはaudienceを検査せず、同じownerの全repository・branch・pull request・environmentを許可している。Browser Workbenchで誤許可を観察し、provider、audience、subjectを別々の境界として修正する。実GitHub token、実AWS account、credential、外向きnetworkは使わない。
instructions: ローカルruntimeを起動してBrowser Workbenchを開く。starter claim matrixで4つの誤許可を観察し、diagnosisとtrustPolicyを修正する。公開testを通して提出値を作り、同じ値を6つのcheckpointへ提出する。
writeup:
## 境界

GitHub OIDC providerを信頼するだけでは、そのprovider内のどのtokenかを限定できない。AWS向けaudienceをStringEqualsで固定し、subを対象repositoryのProduction environment形式へ厳密に束縛する。

## reusable workflow

job_workflow_refは再利用workflowのidentityだが、既定subはcaller側のrepository contextを表す。承認済みreusable workflowを呼んでも、別repositoryのcallerはproduction subjectにならない。本教材はAWSがGitHub custom claimsをtrust conditionに使えない制約に合わせ、provider/actionとaud/subだけを評価する。
learningGoals: issuer、audience、subjectを別々の認証境界として扱える
audienceをsts.amazonaws.comの単一値へfail closedで束縛できる
subjectを対象repositoryのProduction environmentへ厳密に束縛できる
branch、pull request、environment、reusable workflow callerのsubjectを区別できる

hints.content: Workbenchの4つのdeny予定caseが、なぜallowになったかをclaimごとに確認する。
AWS向け標準audienceをStringEqualsで比較し、欠落・配列・別値を拒否する。
owner wildcardではなく、sub内のowner/repositoryを完全一致させる。
environment jobのsubはbranchやpull_requestの形式ではない。

checks.label: PRとreusable callerの混同を拒否する

hints.content: job_workflow_refが承認済みでも、caller repositoryはsubで別に評価される。

checks.label: 順序変更と再評価を決定論的に保つ

hints.content: fallback allowや前caseの状態に依存せず、各requestを同じpolicyで独立評価する。

en.name: Which Workflow Is This Token From?
en.shortDescription: Bind an AWS production role for GitHub Actions OIDC to the intended audience, repository, and environment.
en.description: The long-lived AWS secret was replaced with OIDC, but the production role's starter trust policy never checks the audience and admits every repository, branch, pull request, and environment under the same owner. Observe the false allows in the Browser Workbench, then fix provider, audience, and subject as three separate boundaries. No real GitHub tokens, no real AWS account, no credentials, no outbound network.
en.instructions: Start the local runtime and open Browser Workbench. Observe the starter's four unintended allows, repair diagnosis and trustPolicy, pass the public cases, and submit the same prepared value to all six checkpoints.
en.writeup:
## Boundary

Trusting GitHub's provider does not select a token within that provider. Match the AWS audience exactly and bind sub to the target repository's Production environment.

## Reusable workflows

job_workflow_ref identifies the reusable workflow, while the default sub carries the caller repository context. This lab follows AWS's GitHub custom-claim limitation and evaluates only provider/action plus aud/sub.
learningGoals: Treat issuer, audience, and subject as separate authentication boundaries
Fail closed unless aud is the single sts.amazonaws.com value
Bind sub exactly to the target repository and Production environment
Distinguish branch, pull request, environment, and reusable-workflow caller contexts

hints.content: Inspect why each expected-deny case was allowed, one claim at a time.
Use StringEquals for the AWS audience and reject missing, multi-valued, and different audiences.
Match the owner and repository in sub exactly; an owner wildcard is broader than the role.
An environment job's sub has a different form from branch and pull-request subjects.
An approved job_workflow_ref does not replace the caller repository carried in sub.
Evaluate each request independently without fallback allow or state from a prior case.
